GlobalFoundries is a semiconductor manufacturer developing power-efficient, high-performance solutions for growth markets. The company is seeking an early-career Software Engineer to build and enhance a software performance-tuning application for MIPS RISC-V microprocessors, contributing across front-end and back-end systems while supporting customer onboarding, troubleshooting, and developer workflows.
Electronics
Manufacturing
Semiconductor

Responsibilities
Contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of application features that address customer needs, improve workflows, and enhance the customer experience
Collaborate with engineers, cross-functional teams, and customers to understand requirements and identify opportunities to improve application capabilities
Apply testing, debugging, and performance-analysis techniques to improve software reliability, performance, usability, and compatibility
Participate in code reviews and design discussions, contribute improvements to code quality and team practices, and support customer onboarding and troubleshooting
Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs

Strong planning & organizational skills
Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on software-development experience through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, research, or early professional work
Interest in developer tools, application frameworks, desktop or web applications, data visualization, computer architecture, RISC-V, simulation, performance tuning, or low-level software systems
